nodes.label: GitHub Branch Protection and Secret Scanning
nodes.norm_label: github branch protection and secret scanning

nodes.label: FORECAST_API_KEY
nodes.rationale: Service refuses to start without it (fail closed); same value on both services, never in git.

nodes.label: forecast_api.php Proxy
nodes.rationale: Browser never talks to the forecast service; the PHP proxy checks session, role and inputs before calling Flask with the key.

nodes.label: DEMAND_FEATURES (lags, rolling stats, month, quarter, category_code)
nodes.norm_label: demand_features (lags, rolling stats, month, quarter, category_code)

nodes.label: XGBoost Poisson Demand Model
nodes.rationale: count:poisson objective because units are non-negative counts; beat squared error in both backtests.

nodes.label: requirements.txt (runtime)
nodes.rationale: Runtime-only dependencies for the Render web service; no Excel reader on the web service.

nodes.label: requirements-retrain.txt
nodes.rationale: Adds DB driver and Excel reader for the retrain job only; not installed on Render.

nodes.label: Models Travel Through Git (Ephemeral Render Disk)
nodes.norm_label: models travel through git (ephemeral render disk)

nodes.label: forecast_ro Read-only DB Role
nodes.rationale: Retrain job gets its own read-only user so a leaked CI secret cannot change or read anything else.

nodes.label: XGBoost JSON Models (no pickle)
nodes.rationale: JSON model format means loading a model cannot execute code.

nodes.label: Private Render Service
nodes.rationale: Only the PHP app needs Flask, so it should not be on the public internet.

nodes.label: Single Gunicorn Worker Constraint
nodes.rationale: Rate limiter and reload are per process; move limits to Redis before adding workers.

nodes.label: LEAD_TIME_DAYS Placeholder
nodes.rationale: No supplier role exists, so lead time is a default (7) overridable per product or request until a supplier table exists.

nodes.label: Category-to-Product Share Allocation
nodes.rationale: No per-product models; category forecast is split by each product's 12-month share.

nodes.label: Revenue = Predicted Units x Expected Unit Price
nodes.norm_label: revenue = predicted units x expected unit price
nodes.rationale: Retired separate XGBoost revenue model had 35.0% WAPE vs 18.7% for this rule and compounded recursive errors; revisit with 24+ months of data.

nodes.label: Cron 02:00 UTC on the 2nd
nodes.rationale: Runs on the 2nd (10:00 Manila) so the previous month is closed everywhere.

nodes.label: Accuracy Metrics (MAE, RMSE, WAPE, NRMSE, bias, total-level error)
nodes.norm_label: accuracy metrics (mae, rmse, wape, nrmse, bias, total-level error)

nodes.label: WAPE
nodes.rationale: Scale-free, volume-weighted, safe with zero sales; MAPE not used for that reason.

nodes.label: Monthly Retrain Workflow (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: Retrain runs in CI, not on Render, because Render's disk is ephemeral; new models travel via a PR so a human reviews the gate report before deploy.

nodes.label: Chronological 80/20 Train/Test Split
nodes.rationale: Split by month so test months are never used for fitting or tuning; early stopping uses only the last train months.

nodes.label: Regression Gate
nodes.rationale: If new models are worse than deployed ones nothing is overwritten and the job fails (exit 2); treat as a safety net since the test window moves monthly.
